overview_description.description: LeechProtocol is a decentralized finance technology company that develops an automated cross-chain yield aggregation platform that enables users to deploy cryptocurrency assets into yield farming and liquidity strategies across multiple blockchain ecosystems through a single interface. Supported blockchain networks include BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Optimism, and Arbitrum, with integrations involving decentralized exchanges and protocols such as SushiSwap, Velodrome, THENA, PancakeSwap, Curve, and Stargate.

about_short_description.short_description: LeechProtocol is a decentralized finance platform that develops automated cross-chain yield aggregation for cryptocurrency users.

product.name: Risk Module
product.description: An API-driven AI/ML model that forecasts probabilities of price changes, trading volumes, liquidity, and other market parameters in real-time.

product.name: Liquidity Management Strategy (LMS)
product.description: An automated liquidity allocation service that uses Risk Module predictions to manage liquidity pools on protocols like Uniswap v3, aiming to optimize returns and reduce impermanent loss.

product.name: EasyDefi App
product.description: A web and mobile application that allows retail users to deposit liquidity and earn yield using the Liquidity Management Strategy with simple wallet integration.

product.name: Cross-Chain Yield Farming Aggregator
product.description: A platform that aggregates yield farming opportunities across multiple blockchains, integrating various liquidity pools and protocols for optimized returns.

product.name: msUSD Stablecoin Protocol
product.description: A synthetic asset protocol allowing users to mint synthetic tokens by depositing collateral, with mechanisms to maintain peg stability and treasury security.
